title: Hearty Smoked Ethiopian Pork Stew
description: A fresh and dense Ethiopian dish featuring pork, with a smoky flavor and anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, evoking nostalgic feelings of traditional Ethiopian cuisine.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the smoked paprika and berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pork cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the chopped red bell pepper and cook until it is tender.
Add the chicken broth, tomato paste, and browned pork cubes to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
